==Format==
* '''Play In'''
** Round 1
*** Two groups of 4 teams.
*** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} .
*** Winner of each group advances to Round 2.
** Round 2
*** Two teams from Play In: Round 1 and two seeded teams from North America and Taiwan.
*** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
*** Winners qualifies for Group Stage.
** Round 3
*** Two losing teams from Play In: Round 2
*** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
*** Winner qualifies for Group Stage.
* '''Group Stage'''
** Three teams from Play In and seeded teams from China, Europe and Korea.
** Six teams Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
** Top four teams advance to Knockout Stage
* '''Knockout Stage'''
** Four teams Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}

==Prize Pool==
The base prize pool of the tournament was $250,000 {{Abbr/USD}}.
<br /> 25% of the total sales from the Conqueror Karma and the Conqueror ward skin will contribute the MSI 2017 prize pool from April 24-May 24.
<br /> Guaranteed to be at least $750,000 from the Conqueror Karma and Conqueror ward skin, for a total prize pool of at least $1,000,000.
